title: DemoStream: Batched Task-and-Motion-Plan Optimization for Automated Learning from Demonstration
abstract: arXiv:2610.22020v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learning from demonstration is an effective strategy for endowing robots with manipulation capabilities but requires training on datasets comprised of massive amounts of demonstrations. Existing demonstration collection approaches either require constant human involvement, for example, via teleoperation or are specialized for a single task. Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) systems are able to autonomously solve and therefore generate demonstrations for general-purpose tasks; however, learning from their demonstrations has proven difficult due to multi-modality in their solutions. In this work, we build on recent work leveraging GPU acceleration for TAMP and propose DemoStream, a TAMP system that optimizes demonstration quality in order to improve behavior cloning success rates. translated_title: DemoStream：面向自动演示学习的批量任务与运动规划优化
translated_abstract: 从演示中学习是为机器人赋予操作能力的有效策略，但需要在由海量演示构成的数据集上进行训练。现有的演示收集方法要么需要人类的持续参与（例如通过遥操作），要么是针对单一任务的专用方法。任务与运动规划系统能够自主求解，因此可以为通用任务生成演示；然而，由于其解的多模态性，从这些演示中学习已被证明十分困难。在本工作中，我们基于近期利用GPU加速进行TAMP的研究，提出了DemoStream——一个能够优化演示质量以提升行为克隆成功率的TAMP系统。首先，我们引入了批量TAMP采样操作以及相应地执行批量约束满足的新型TAMP算法，从而……
tldr: 本文提出DemoStream，一个基于GPU加速的批量任务与运动规划（TAMP）系统，通过批量约束满足优化演示质量，自动生成高质量演示数据以提升机器人行为克隆的成功率。
en_tdlr: DemoStream is a GPU-accelerated batched Task-and-Motion-Planning (TAMP) system that performs batched constraint satisfaction to optimize demonstration quality, enabling automated generation of high-quality demonstrations to improve behavior cloning success rates.
